newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sino Land to complete land deal on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Sino Land to complete land deal on schedule.

text.p: Property group Sino Land Co Ltd said it intended to complete its purchase of a site at Siu Sai Wan in Hong Kong's Chai Wan district on schedule.

"The company reaffirms its intention to complete the acquisition of the site on the scheduled completion date of 22nd April, 1997," the company said in a statement issued through the Hong Kong stock exchange on Tuesday.
Sino Land said it made the statement in response to rumours concerning the completion of its acquisition of the site, which it agreed to acquire at a government land auction on March 25.
"Those rumours are without foundation," the statement said.
Sino Land has proposed a US$130 million convertible bond issue to raise funds for the purchase and development of properties in Hong Kong, including the Chai Wan site.
The company and its chairman's family jointly bought the Chai Wan site for HK$11.82 billion at the government land auction.
Sino Land shares were down HK$0.15 to HK$7.10 at midday.
